verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the /stages endpoint. It returns recruitment pipeline stages "as defined in recruiting preferences page," which implies stages are configurable in the product, but only at the account level as documented. Nothing in the pack shows per-job custom stages, drag-to-move, or bulk actions. missing for 10: per-job custom stage configuration, drag-and-drop candidate movement between stages, bulk actions across the pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Calling the /stages endpoint will return a collection of the recruitment pipeline stages as defined in recruiting preferences page
